candidates.requirement: Set PCRE2_EXTRA_NEVER_CALLOUT on the compile context used to compile a pattern containing an explicit (?C) callout.
candidates.target_route: The fuzzer can supply (?C) as pattern bytes and passes its compile context to pcre2_compile.
candidates.failure_condition: The fuzzer never sets compile extra options. The created context retains the default value of zero, so input bytes cannot enable the new rejection branch.
candidates.alternative_paths: The ordinary compile-options mask does not set context extra options. Automatic callouts and match-time callout configuration do not exercise rejection of an explicit callout under PCRE2_EXTRA_NEVER_CALLOUT. The pcre2test and pcre2grep routes are separate executables.
